message: Agent registration completed successfully with auto-approval. Identity recorded in audit log and agent status confirmed as active.
JWT token authentication successful. CLI cached valid token with 1-hour validity during registration flow.
API catalog discovery successful. Agent enumerated 5,981 available APIs via catalog endpoint.

Agent encountered initial friction with API reference format (attempted 'jentic-test/test-api' which failed with 422 error expecting 'vendor/name/version'). Successfully located test API after correcting reference format via `apis` command.
Test API found in local registry. Agent accessed API details and confirmed authentication requirements.
Operations endpoint successfully queried. Agent listed available operations on test API.
OpenAPI specification endpoint accessed successfully. Agent retrieved and examined operation specs.
Agent encountered error with initial toolkit access request (exit code 1, invalid action 'create'; expected 'bind' or 'grant'). Corrected approach and successfully requested access.
Toolkit access request filed and approved. Agent received credential binding for test API.
Proxied GET request to test API executed successfully through Jentic broker. Execution record created with full audit trail; test API received request with broker-injected credentials.
